Mäntsälä, the hardest-hit municipality at 61 road km from the Helsinki unit, has 0 nights away with 15 breast sessions and 0 with 5 [S60, S33, S57, S34, S35].

1. The head of radiotherapy could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases, with equal pain relief and more retreatment [S31, S30, S32, S62]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews which cases are uncomplicated, for the indicator "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S31, S30, S25, S24]. For Mäntsälä, expected nights away are 0.0 with the multi-fraction course and 0.0 with a single 8 Gy session [S60, S59, S30].

2. The head of radiotherapy could evaluate 5 sessions as default for eligible patients, citing distance, as it is non-inferior to 15 sessions [S9, S11, S15, S14]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews who is eligible (whole breast or chest wall, no nodal radiotherapy), for the indicator "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S15, S14, S25, S24]. Yearly, this removes 0 nights away and frees 645 machine sessions (calculated for breast cancer) [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60].

Within 30 days, the director of cancer services and the clinical team decide which figures to report in a yearly publication of schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band, for the indicator "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S21, S26].

Distances are road km from municipality centre points and the current schedule mix is unknown [S59, S60, S16].
